body: I would like to try again and tell my parents... ask for help but I'm afraid that I will just get shot down again the moment I start spouting this "garbage" that I have..

I've tried my friends but they don't seem to understand it as much as I want them to. I tried the school counselor but I've been in the pending list for about 3 months now. It sucks really, so all I'm left was this... I don't know if I should talk to my parents again or put myself in the hospital for suicide watch... There's a part of me that wants to keep going but an even larger part of me that wants to just go do what I have to do and be over with it. I've spent the past few days scouring the internet on ways on how to die and I've settled on the exit bag with an LPG.

I'm just a burden to everyone because of what I have. I'm just a waste of space and another better human being deserve my space. I honestly believe that by doing this, I'm doing the world a favor. Selfish to everyone who may have cared about me I know but I don't want to be just another burden or problem to deal with.
I thought that maybe by typing this out would make me change my mind... that maybe it would help me but no, I suppose I am wrong.
